title: John Summit Announces 2026 [UNVRS] Ibiza Residency: ‘We’re Going All Out’
summary: The residency will be a pillar of the island mega-club's second season.
contentText:
John Summit will be a 2026 resident at Ibiza mega-club [UNVRS], the producer and venue announced Tuesday (Jan. 20). This Experts Only residency, named for Summit’s label of the same name , will be his first on the island. The nine-date run will be happen at the club on Monday nights, from June 1 to July 27.

“From the moment I stepped into [UNVRS], I knew we had to bring Experts Only there,” Summit said in a statement. “The sound, the production, the energy — it’s unlike anything I’ve experienced in a club. Bringing my event to the best venue in the world’s dance music capital is a dream come true. We’re going all out every week this June and July, and I can’t wait to see you on the island.”

With the announcement, Summit joins fellow [UNVRS] 2026 residents David Guetta , who will play Friday nights from June 19 to Oct. 2, Spanish party brand Elrow, which is taking over the club on Sundays, and Carl Cox , who will play the club on Sunday nights from June 21 to Oct. 4.

[UNVRS] opened to great fanfare last season, with the state of the art venue opening with a residency from Eric Prydz and his Holosphere 2.0 production . The club is a venture from its founder Yann Pissenem and his company The Night League, which also operates the Ibiza clubs Hï and Ushuaïa.

Meanwhile Summit has made myriad appearances on the island since 2022 and has graduated to increasingly larger venues around the world over the last few years, with 2025 Summit sets including a stadium show at Boulder’s Folsom Field last October, a headlining slot at Austin City Limits and the September debut of his own Experts Only festival, which will return to New York City this fall.
